summary: Comprehensive frontend E2E testing of LeftoverLab (frontend-only React app with mock localStorage data & mock auth). Tested 40+ critical assertions across landing, cafeteria, shop dashboard, mess, Sunday brunch logic, anonymous feedback, mess login/data entry, shop owner scoping, admin dashboard/guard, logout, and mobile responsiveness. All feature areas listed in the review request pass.
critical_code_review_comments: services/api.js caches loaded data in a module-level `cache` variable. Data written by one tab session will not be picked up by another tab until a full reload. Acceptable for demo but worth noting.

seedData() runs against today's date but the seeded 30-day window is fixed at first load. If the app runs across a day boundary without clearing localStorage, 'today' bars will be empty until re-seeded. Consider always re-seeding the last N days on load, or seeding on demand.
Login route uses `/login/:role/:shopId?` — no validation that role is one of mess/shop/admin; unknown roles silently render a broken login. Consider a whitelist + 404.
MEAL_LABELS + MEAL_COLORS are exported but shop dashboard/mess share styling logic — fine, just a note.
Sunday brunch logic (mealsForDate) is duplicated between seed and UI filters — good single-source-of-truth already; keep it that way in future edits.
Report seed IDs (`r-seed-*`) and new report IDs (`r-<Date.now()>`) will collide if two reports are submitted in the same millisecond — unlikely but consider crypto.randomUUID().
seed_data_creation: None — data seeded automatically by services/api.js on first load. Test run submitted 1 mock feedback (mess, 4-star) and 1 mess waste entry (TEST Rice 2.5kg + TEST Sabzi 1.3kg on lunch of today). These will persist in localStorage for that browser only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 review-request items verified passing. Playwright-scale flakes: (a) shop-card-amul is_visible check occasionally returns false immediately after navigation — retest with a small wait; on retest element is present & visible. (b) Mobile horizontal-overflow check at 390px also flaked on first pass but returned 0 overflowing elements on retest — no real overflow. Key working flows: Landing nav, Cafeteria grid + open, Shop 7/30 toggle + date picker empty-state, Mess meal-filter + day/week toggle + Sunday brunch swap, Anonymous feedback submit + confirmation + reset + shop-select dropdown, Mess login wrong-pass error + correct login + multi-item entry submit + logout, Shop-owner entry-form scoping (own-shop only), Admin guard lock screen + admin login + drill links + report filters (date + clear), Mobile @390px landing & mess render without overflow.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Two initial FAILs were Playwright timing false-negatives, both confirmed clean on retest.
